Configure self-hosted and X API sources

The official X API is not free for general v2 access. Bring your own developer credentials from a project with active paid or pay-per-use X API access, and Twidget will call X directly from your device.
The official X API is expensive, and not viable for a small project like this. Which is why we don’t provide it. You can bring your own credentials if you’d prefer.
FxTwitter is a free public API that needs no credentials. Twidget calls it directly from your device. With shared history enabled, the Twidget bridge steps in as a fallback.
The shared Twidget bridge powers the community history pool and acts as a backup for FxTwitter when it\'s unavailable. It is only contacted when shared history is on or a bridge source is selected.
Run your own self-hosted bridge and point Twidget to it. When the URL is empty, the shared Twidget bridge is used instead. The optional token is sent as a Bearer token to protected instances.

Get a personalised briefing on your profile, based on tweet activity, your goals and tweeting schedule.
Preview of a personalised Your Brief

Get a personalised daily briefing based on your Twitter activity, recent tweets, your goals and tweeting schedule. It changes as your day does, and appears in your dashboard and as a home screen widget.

It uses a data aggregation engine, as well as your choice of local or cloud powered models. Local uses Gemini Nano on supported devices, while cloud uses the Google AI Studio API for use with Gemini models.
Posting rhythm uses your original tweets to show when you’re building a consistent streak or when it may be worth posting again. Replies don’t count.

Schedule suggestions surface one useful action when a queued tweet needs attention, a draft is ready to schedule, or your calendar has a gap of more than three days. Automatic schedule suggestions do not send unpublished tweet text to the AI provider. On-demand draft coaching follows your local or cloud AI setting.

Scheduled tweet performance connects a scheduled tweet with its live results. When it performs meaningfully above or below your usual tweets, Your Brief highlights what may be worth carrying into the next one.
Next tweet guidance highlights measured patterns in your recent posts. Draft and tweet reviews have their own Tweet reviews switch at the top of Manage content.
Choose the updates you want to see in Brief settings.
